“Because I’m looking for a role where I can work directly with customers every day. In my current position I’m mainly handling deliveries and back‑of‑house tasks, and I really enjoy the customer‑facing side of retail. Maple Grocers’ store associate role lets me use my cash‑handling and stocking experience while spending more time on the floor greeting shoppers and helping them find products.”

You highlight the parts of your current job you already do well (cash handling, stocking) and explain that you want more customer interaction, which matches the posting. Avoid mentioning any negative aspects of your current employer or saying you’re “bored.”  

Next steps:  
1. Practice saying it out loud a few times so it sounds natural.  
2. Keep it under 30 seconds; stay on point about the customer‑focus you’re after.  
3. If they ask for more detail, you can add a brief line about how you’ve already trained cashiers and would love to bring that skill to a larger team.
